parameters.query: UPDATE resume_data SET interview_status = 'INTERVIEW_INVITED' WHERE email = $1;

INSERT INTO interview_schedules (candidate_name, candidate_email, job_id, role_title, interviewer_id, scheduled_time, google_event_id, status, round_number, round_label, meeting_link) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'scheduled', $8, $9, $10 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interview_schedules s WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.candidate_email)) = LOWER(TRIM($2)) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.job_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(s.role_title), ''), 'default') = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM($3), ''), NULLIF(TRIM($4), ''), 'default') AND s.status IN ('scheduled', 'in_progress'));

parameters.query: UPDATE interview_schedules SET reminder_24h_sent = (CASE WHEN scheduled_time > NOW() + INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN true ELSE reminder_24h_sent END), reminder_1h_sent = (CASE WHEN scheduled_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN true ELSE reminder_1h_sent END) WHERE id = $1;

SELECT s.id AS interview_id, s.candidate_name, s.candidate_email, s.round_number FROM interview_schedules s WHERE s.feedback_submitted = TRUE AND s.status NOT LIKE 'decision_%' AND s.status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY s.scheduled_time DESC LIMIT 20;
